foundation.proof_scope: v15 complete Pluto library package official plan/apply and host lib/bin type checks; not complete TConstruct consumer or runtime proof

limitations: Parent links are current open PR head-ref/base-ref matches, not merge-base or semantic dependency proof.
reported_base_sha is GitHub PR metadata and may differ from the separately verified current main ref.
The paginated read is not an atomic repository snapshot; exact heads and refs must be re-read before any write.
This preserves open PRs only. Closed or merged base histories still need a separate audit.
No final PR-to-category assignment or duplicate-patch claim is inferred from titles.
Focused library tests do not certify unmerged feature PRs or live gameplay.
All PR state, refs, reviews, approvals, CI dispatches and merge settings were left unchanged.
